OpenCC (Open Chinese Convert) character table, used for the Traditional Chinese interface.

Source: https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC, data/dictionary/STCharacters.txt
License: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE)

app/src/main/java/io/wenyou/textquest/ui/common/I18nTraditional.kt holds the single-character Simplified -> Traditional
mappings from STCharacters.txt (first candidate of each entry, characters inside the Basic Multilingual Plane), followed
by a short list of Taiwan wording for common interface terms written for this app.
